Great question! Here's how visibility works on Cartwheel (cw-roles):

**Shoppers** can see and manage their own orders only.

**Merchants** can see and manage orders placed at their own store. They cannot see orders from other stores or view their shoppers' purchases elsewhere.

**Support staff** can look up any order on the platform to help with issues.

These permissions are built into the system, so they can't be overridden even by support. Does that help clarify things?
